headline: From the Nuclear Program to the Strait of Hormuz: Under What Conditions Will Trump Declare Victory in the War With Iran
summary: Trump has repeatedly said an agreement with Iran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz is nearly reached. Tehran's conditions put forward on Saturday make such a deal seem less realistic.
why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of the world's seaborne oil, so its status is a key driver of global energy supply and prices.
why_moved: Tehran's new conditions make a Hormuz reopening deal seem less realistic, keeping Gulf shipping and oil supply risk elevated.
